summary.text: Berry Forte is a Democratic member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 84, elected November 2, 2010.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative profile, he worked at American Buildings in Eufaula for 45 years and served 29 years on the Barbour County Commission.
The profile lists him as a member of the Barbour County Hospital Board and the Southeast Alabama Regional Planning and Development Commission.
